quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
الٓمٓ
أَحَسِبَ ٱلنَّاسُ أَن يُتْرَكُوٓا۟ أَن يَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ
وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۖ فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا۟ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَسْبِقُونَا ۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
مَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ لِقَآءَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ لَءَاتٍۢ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
وَمَن جَٰهَدَ فَإِنَّمَا يُجَٰهِدُ لِنَفْسِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَنِىٌّ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَحْسَنَ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ حُسْنًۭا ۖ وَإِن جَٰهَدَاكَ لِتُشْرِكَ بِى مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَآ ۚ إِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ فَإِذَآ أُوذِىَ فِى ٱللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ ٱلنَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَئِن جَآءَ نَصْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمْ ۚ أَوَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِمَا فِى صُدُورِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ
وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ سَبِيلَنَا وَلْنَحْمِلْ خَطَٰيَٰكُمْ وَمَا هُم بِحَٰمِلِينَ مِنْ خَطَٰيَٰهُم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
وَلَيَحْمِلُنَّ أَثْقَالَهُمْ وَأَثْقَالًۭا مَّعَ أَثْقَالِهِمْ ۖ وَلَيُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًۭا فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَٰلِمُونَ
فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَأَصْحَٰبَ ٱلسَّفِينَةِ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ ۖ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

إِنَّمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْثَٰنًۭا وَتَخْلُقُونَ إِفْكًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لَكُمْ رِزْقًۭا فَٱبْتَغُوا۟ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرِّزْقَ وَٱعْبُدُوهُ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لَهُۥٓ ۖ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
وَإِن تُكَذِّبُوا۟ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أُمَمٌۭ مِّن قَبْلِكُمْ ۖ وَمَا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ يُبْدِئُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ
قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ بَدَأَ ٱلْخَلْقَ ۚ ثُمَّ ٱللَّهُ يُنشِئُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
يُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْحَمُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ تُقْلَبُونَ
وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا نَصِيرٍۢ
وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِقَآئِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَئِسُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَتِى وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱقْتُلُوهُ أَوْ حَرِّقُوهُ فَأَنجَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ

وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا ٱتَّخَذْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْثَٰنًۭا مَّوَدَّةَ بَيْنِكُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ ثُمَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ يَكْفُرُ بَعْضُكُم بِبَعْضٍۢ وَيَلْعَنُ بَعْضُكُم بَعْضًۭا وَمَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
۞ فَـَٔامَنَ لَهُۥ لُوطٌۭ ۘ وَقَالَ إِنِّى مُهَاجِرٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ذُرِّيَّتِهِ ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ أَجْرَهُۥ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلْفَٰحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُم بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ وَتَقْطَعُونَ ٱلسَّبِيلَ وَتَأْتُونَ فِى نَادِيكُمُ ٱلْمُنكَرَ ۖ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱئْتِنَا بِعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
وَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ بِٱلْبُشْرَىٰ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مُهْلِكُوٓا۟ أَهْلِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ۖ إِنَّ أَهْلَهَا كَانُوا۟ ظَٰلِمِينَ
قَالَ إِنَّ فِيهَا لُوطًۭا ۚ قَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن فِيهَا ۖ لَنُنَجِّيَنَّهُۥ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ كَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
وَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًۭا سِىٓءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًۭا وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ ۖ إِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَكَ كَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَا مِنْهَآ ءَايَةًۢ بَيِّنَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ
وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًۭا فَقَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْءَاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دَارِهِمْ جَٰثِمِينَ
وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ ۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ
وَقَٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَٰبِقِينَ

فَكُلًّا أَخَذْنَا بِذَنۢبِهِۦ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ حَاصِبًۭا وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَخَذَتْهُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ خَسَفْنَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَغْرَقْنَا ۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
مَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْلِيَآءَ كَمَثَلِ ٱلْعَنكَبُوتِ ٱتَّخَذَتْ بَيْتًۭا ۖ وَإِنَّ أَوْهَنَ ٱلْبُيُوتِ لَبَيْتُ ٱلْعَنكَبُوتِ ۖ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأَمْثَٰلُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ ۖ وَمَا يَعْقِلُهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْعَٰلِمُونَ
خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ٱتْلُ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلَذِكْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ

۞ وَلَا تُجَٰدِلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَأُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَإِلَٰهُنَا وَإِلَٰهُكُمْ وَٰحِدٌۭ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ
وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَمِنْ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَٰبٍۢ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًۭا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
بَلْ هُوَ ءَايَٰتٌۢ بَيِّنَٰتٌۭ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ ۚ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۖ قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْءَايَٰتُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِهِمْ أَنَّآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَرَحْمَةًۭ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ
قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ شَهِيدًۭا ۖ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ وَكَفَرُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ
وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ ۚ وَلَوْلَآ أَجَلٌۭ مُّسَمًّۭى لَّجَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَلَيَأْتِيَنَّهُم بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
يَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةٌۢ بِٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
يَوْمَ يَغْشَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِهِمْ وَيَقُولُ ذُوقُوا۟ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
يَٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ أَرْضِى وَٰسِعَةٌۭ فَإِيَّٰىَ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ غُرَفًۭا تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ نِعْمَ أَجْرُ ٱلْعَٰمِلِينَ
ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
وَكَأَيِّن مِّن دَآبَّةٍۢ لَّا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا ٱللَّهُ يَرْزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمْ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
ٱللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ
وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّن نَّزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَوْتِهَا لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۚ قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
وَمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا لَهْوٌۭ وَلَعِبٌۭ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ لَهِىَ ٱلْحَيَوَانُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
فَإِذَا رَكِبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ دَعَوُا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ إِذَا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا حَرَمًا ءَامِنًۭا وَيُتَخَطَّفُ ٱلنَّاسُ مِنْ حَوْلِهِمْ ۚ أَفَبِٱلْبَٰطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَكْفُرُونَ
وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُۥٓ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًۭى لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ
وَٱلَّذِينَ جَٰهَدُوا۟ فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمَعَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

parent_channels.name: P1 (29:1-13) Verification Under Pressure

subchannels.name: Fire-Assay and the Mark of Sound Material
subchannels.scene_or_process: Metal or another material enters heat, changes visibly, and is judged by whether its solidity and promised performance survive.
subchannels.active_motifs: assaying metal and persons `quranic:root_001128:B001/m01`; burning and blackening by fire `quranic:root_001128:B002/m01`; material solidity and straightness `quranic:root_000852:B002/m01`; realization of promise in action `quranic:root_000852:B004/m01`; a distinguishing mark `quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`; a covering laid over what is beneath `quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Trial is not only adversity but an assay that separates sound from unsound material. Truth is both a hard, straight substance and a promise realized under stress, while knowledge reads the resulting mark through any attempted covering.

subchannels.name: Spoken Profession and the Unvoiced Interior
subchannels.scene_or_process: An utterance leaves the tongue while an unvoiced formulation, intention, and causal source remain within the person.
subchannels.active_motifs: articulated speech `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`; speech held inward before utterance `quranic:root_001272:B012/m01`; inward intention `quranic:root_001533:B013/m01`; the source from which actions issue `quranic:root_000849:B004/m01`; knowledge as disclosure to a knower `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; the lying self `quranic:root_001290:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The professed "we believe" is one layer of a speech event; beneath it sit an unspoken proposition, intention, and the source of subsequent action. Divine knowing therefore reaches the point where language is still interior and distinguishes the lying self before public wording can stabilize its claim.

subchannels.name: Injury Amplified as Public Circulation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Harmful speech enters public circulation, becomes reputation or scandal, and escalates into communal disturbance.
subchannels.active_motifs: injurious utterance `quranic:root_000023:B001/m01`; talk circulating among people `quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`; public reputation and notoriety `quranic:root_000741:B005/m01`; insulting or shaming speech `quranic:root_000741:B006/m01`; conflict and division among people `quranic:root_001128:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The "harm concerning God" can be pressured by a social acoustics in which an injury is repeated, acquires notoriety, and becomes factional disturbance. This makes the human trial in 29:10 a mechanism of public amplification rather than an isolated wound.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Pressure makes an inward quality externally legible by testing material, speech, and conduct.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:2-3,10 (ف ت ن), 29:3 (ص د ق), 29:2,10,12 (ق و ل), and 29:10 (ص د ر) stage profession, trial, truth, and what is held in breasts.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The passage's epistemic test acquires the concrete mechanics of fire-assay, diagnostic marking, hidden speech, and socially circulating noise.

parent_channels.name: P1 (29:1-13) Liability Carried to Settlement

subchannels.name: Load, Surety, and Inseparable Liability
subchannels.scene_or_process: A visible load is taken up under a guarantee, but the attached liability follows the responsible party and adds weight.
subchannels.active_motifs: an external load borne on back, head, mount, or vessel `quranic:root_000357:B001/m01`; entrusted burden or culpability `quranic:root_000357:B003/m01`; surety for damages and obligations `quranic:root_000357:B004/m01`; physical or figurative heaviness `quranic:root_000202:B001/m01`; calibrated weight `quranic:root_000202:B004/m01`; liability that follows its cause `quranic:root_000175:B006/m01`; deliberate offense `quranic:root_000420:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The promise to "carry your sins" sounds like a surety agreement, yet liability is not detached freight. It remains a following claim, so the guarantor accumulates another weighted obligation instead of substituting for the original actor.

subchannels.name: Account, Claim, and Final Discharge
subchannels.scene_or_process: Conduct enters an account, a claimant asks for settlement, weight is assessed, and recompense answers the act.
subchannels.active_motifs: counting and accounting `quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`; reciprocal recompense for an act `quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`; one thing attempting to stand in for another `quranic:root_000244:B002/m01`; collection and discharge of debt `quranic:root_000244:B003/m01`; asking and claiming `quranic:root_000661:B001/m01`; judicial decision between parties `quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`; intentional work `quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The local language forms a settlement scene: deeds are counted, claims are heard, substitution is tested, and judgment answers intentional work. Recompense is thus the discharge of a properly attributed account, not a transferable slogan.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An obligation remains attached to its actor as a load, guarantee, account, and claim until it is weighed and settled.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:12-13 repeatedly joins ح م ل, خ ط ء, and ث ق ل, while 29:7 and 29:13 supply recompense and questioning.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Moral burden is materialized as freight, surety, debt collection, and calibrated weight rather than as an abstract quantity.

parent_channels.name: P1 (29:1-13) Tracked Roads and the Appointed Encounter

subchannels.name: Worked Track, Foot Travelers, and Road Gear
subchannels.scene_or_process: Walkers follow a worked route by successive traces while footwear and the road's grooves keep bodies aligned to it.
subchannels.active_motifs: an extended road `quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`; road users and travelers `quranic:root_000672:B002/m01`; a well-used worked road `quranic:root_001046:B011/m01`; travelers proceeding on foot `quranic:root_001046:B012/m01`; a sandal strap `quranic:root_000791:B004/m01`; road grooves and main tracks `quranic:root_000791:B005/m01`; tracing an effect step by step `quranic:root_000175:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: "Follow our path" is materialized as foot travel on a worked road whose repeated use has cut tracks into it. The sandal strap and road-groove senses make adherence bodily and infrastructural: a route recruits feet through its fitted gear and visible traces.

subchannels.name: Race, Finish, and Unavoidable Reception
subchannels.scene_or_process: A runner tries to gain precedence, but the pursuer closes the distance at a fixed terminus where encounter and return occur.
subchannels.active_motifs: precedence in a race `quranic:root_000671:B001/m01`; escaping beyond a pursuer's reach `quranic:root_000671:B004/m01`; two parties meeting face to face `quranic:root_001372:B004/m01`; what one meets of good or harm `quranic:root_001372:B007/m01`; a fixed temporal limit `quranic:root_000016:B001/m01`; arrival at a traveled terminus `quranic:root_000009:B010/m01`; arrival of calamity or death `quranic:root_000009:B011/m01`; return to the point or state of origin `quranic:root_000544:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The attempted escape in 29:4 is a failed race: precedence cannot erase the fixed finish. The coming term is simultaneously a route-end, an arriving event, a face-to-face meeting, and a return.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Directed movement leaves a followable track and terminates at an encounter that cannot be outrun.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:4-5 opposes attempted precedence to the coming term and meeting, while 29:12 commands following a path and 29:8 names return.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The moral route becomes a worked road with travelers, ruts, sandal-straps, pursuit, a finish, and an unavoidable reception.

parent_channels.name: P2 (29:14-27) Manufactured Allegiance and Its Reversal

subchannels.name: Idol, Owner, and Servile Hierarchy
subchannels.scene_or_process: An object is installed as a worshiped superior, people submit in service, and possession and sovereignty make the arrangement durable.
subchannels.active_motifs: a made object of worship `quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`; a worshiped idol or stone `quranic:root_001624:B001/m01`; submissive ritual service `quranic:root_000973:B003/m01`; reducing another to servile labor `quranic:root_000973:B004/m01`; ownership and disposal of property `quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`; sovereignty and rule `quranic:root_001444:B003/m01`; an inferior substitute `quranic:root_000502:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The idols are placed inside an ownership hierarchy: the worshiper behaves as a servant while attributing rule and disposal to an inferior object. The lexical scene exposes the social labor required to manufacture a "master."

subchannels.name: Affection as an Alliance Contract
subchannels.scene_or_process: Shared attachment to a cultic object binds parties through proximity, patronage, and a connective social compact.
subchannels.active_motifs: affection and mutual love `quranic:root_001634:B001/m01`; Wadd as a named idol `quranic:root_001634:B005/m01`; loving and protective alliance `quranic:root_001684:B004/m01`; legal clientage `quranic:root_001684:B005/m01`; a connective relation between parties `quranic:root_000170:B003/m01`; taking and possessing an object `quranic:root_000018:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: "Affection among you" behaves like alliance infrastructure: proximity, protection, clientage, and possession gather around a shared object. Wadd's lexical identity as an idol sharpens the pun by making affection itself both bond and cultic name.

subchannels.name: Repudiation, Separation, and Expulsion
subchannels.scene_or_process: The alliance is disowned, its connective middle is cut, parties turn away, and each drives the other beyond protection.
subchannels.active_motifs: repudiation and disavowal `quranic:root_001307:B005/m01`; separation after connection `quranic:root_000170:B001/m01`; irrevocable severance `quranic:root_000170:B012/m01`; turning away and abandoning proximity `quranic:root_001684:B007/m01`; expulsion under wrath `quranic:root_001359:B001/m01`; reciprocal imprecation `quranic:root_001359:B004/m01`; aid against an adversary `quranic:root_001510:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The eschatological reversal dismantles every relation that sustained the idol compact. Affection becomes mutual disavowal, connection becomes irrevocable separation, patronage becomes withdrawal, and blessing is replaced by reciprocal expulsion.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A cultic object becomes powerful through service, possession, affection, and alliance, then those same relations reverse into repudiation and expulsion.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:16-17 and 29:25 join worship, idols, possession, mutual affection, denial, cursing, and absent aid.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Idolatry appears less as a static object class than as a deliberately assembled social and property regime whose bonds later run backward.

parent_channels.name: P2 (29:14-27) The Message Made Visible

subchannels.name: Dispatch, Carriage, and Clear Delivery
subchannels.scene_or_process: A sender releases a bearer, the bearer carries a consequential report, and expression reaches the intended recipient clearly.
subchannels.active_motifs: dispatch and release `quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`; messenger and carried message `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`; delivery of a message `quranic:root_000151:B002/m01`; reaching an endpoint `quranic:root_000151:B001/m01`; eloquence that reaches its purpose `quranic:root_000151:B004/m01`; spoken clarification `quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`; a consequential report arriving `quranic:root_001464:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The messenger is a carrier whose task is completed when the communication reaches its limit. "Clear delivery" therefore combines transport and intelligibility: the report arrives and opens its meaning rather than merely occupying the recipient's hearing.

subchannels.name: Sign, Banner, and Deliberate Inspection
subchannels.scene_or_process: A visible mark is raised or distinguished, observers direct eye and judgment toward it, and concealed structure becomes known.
subchannels.active_motifs: a manifest sign `quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`; a route-guiding landmark `quranic:root_001040:B002/m02`; an identifying banner `quranic:root_001040:B002/m03`; sensory and inward vision `quranic:root_000531:B001/m01`; a raised banner visible at distance `quranic:root_000531:B011/m01`; directed visual and reflective inspection `quranic:root_001520:B001/m01`; emergence into clarity `quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The ark, fire-rescue, and recreated world function as raised evidence rather than inert spectacle. A sign is a landmark that solicits disciplined inspection until what was merely visible becomes inwardly known.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A dispatched communication reaches its limit by becoming an intelligible, inspectable mark.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:14,18 name sending and clear delivery, while 29:15,19-20,23-24 repeatedly call for seeing signs and creation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Communication is simultaneously courier-work, eloquent arrival, landmark, banner, and trained observation.

parent_channels.name: P2 (29:14-27) Origin, Measure, and Return

subchannels.name: Pre-Measure, First Cut, and Construction
subchannels.scene_or_process: A maker measures material, determines its limit, opens the work, and establishes the first structural parts.
subchannels.active_motifs: measuring before cutting or acting `quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`; originating a made thing `quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`; quantity and limit `quranic:root_001205:B001/m01`; planning by prior measurement `quranic:root_001205:B005/m01`; preparing and fitting a form `quranic:root_001205:B005/m02`; opening and prioritizing the first stage `quranic:root_000090:B001/m01`; producing and bringing into existence `quranic:root_001502:B006/m01`; first members or stones of a basin `quranic:root_001502:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The first creation is a workshop sequence: measure precedes cut, opening precedes assembly, and foundational pieces establish the form. The concrete craft sense makes "how creation began" an invitation to inspect fitted production.

subchannels.name: Reversal, Return, and Renewed Emergence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A completed form is turned, sent back toward its point of return, and made to emerge again.
subchannels.active_motifs: beginning paired with repetition `quranic:root_000090:B002/m01`; return after departure `quranic:root_001058:B001/m01`; destination of return `quranic:root_001058:B002/m01`; turning a thing from one face to another `quranic:root_001248:B004/m01`; final destination or outcome `quranic:root_001248:B005/m01`; return to an earlier state `quranic:root_000544:B001/m01`; rising and coming forward `quranic:root_001502:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Re-creation is not a second unrelated manufacture but a controlled reversal of an existing trajectory. The object is turned, reaches its return-point, and rises into a renewed emergence.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Making proceeds through prior measure and first construction, then proves its power by turning the made thing back into renewed existence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:17,19-20 join creating, beginning, redoing, and a later emergence, while 29:21 names reversal toward God.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Creation is rendered as leather-cutting, measurement, foundation work, assembly, and a reversible production cycle.

parent_channels.name: P2 (29:14-27) Water Governing Survival

subchannels.name: Encircling Flood and Worked Floating Craft
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water surrounds the settlement while shaped timber, roughening tools, and bound floats produce a surface that can cross it.
subchannels.active_motifs: overwhelming encircling flood `quranic:root_000957:B002/m01`; a bound raft of skins or timber `quranic:root_000957:B006/m01`; stripping and shaping a surface `quranic:root_000716:B001/m01`; woodworking or roughening tool `quranic:root_000716:B002/m01`; ship cutting the water's face `quranic:root_000716:B003/m01`; swimming or vessel-motion `quranic:root_001063:B001/m01`; a branch-float for crossing water `quranic:root_001063:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The ship appears as a worked counter-form to encircling water: surfaces are stripped, timber is shaped, and pieces are bound into buoyancy. The same root field that names the flood also supplies the primitive raft that crosses it.

subchannels.name: Extraction to Flood-Safe Height
subchannels.scene_or_process: Persons separate from danger through rapid movement and reach an elevated place beyond the flood-line.
subchannels.active_motifs: escape by separation `quranic:root_001476:B001/m01`; rapid departure `quranic:root_001476:B002/m01`; raised ground beyond flood reach `quranic:root_001476:B004/m01`; companionship and close attendance `quranic:root_000844:B001/m01`; preservation through accompaniment `quranic:root_000844:B002/m01`; land as the lower supporting surface `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Rescue has a topography: separation from the destructive medium, accelerated movement, and arrival on a raised safe place. Noah's companions and Abraham's rescue are locally joined by extraction that preserves an accompanied group.

subchannels.name: Rain-Apportioned Life and Gratitude
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rain descends as a measured allotment, revives land and animals, and makes a small input visibly productive.
subchannels.active_motifs: apportioned gift `quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`; nourishment entering the body `quranic:root_000560:B002/m01`; rain as provision `quranic:root_000560:B003/m01`; land vivified by rain and growth `quranic:root_000383:B002/m01`; gratitude that recognizes a benefactor `quranic:root_000810:B001/m01`; small feed or rain yielding visible increase `quranic:root_000810:B002/m01`; abundant milk after pasture `quranic:root_000810:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Provision is not only possessed food; it is rainfall entering a living production system. Gratitude reads the disproportion between a small received input and the greening, fattening, or milk-yield that follows.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Water can encircle and destroy, support a crossing craft, preserve life on raised ground, or descend as apportioned nourishment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:14-15 gives flood and ship, 29:15 and 29:24 give rescue, and 29:17 makes provision the object of seeking and gratitude.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Destruction and sustenance share one hydrological system of enclosure, flotation, elevation, rainfall, and living yield.

parent_channels.name: P2 (29:14-27) Generative Continuity

subchannels.name: Seed Scattering, Covering, and Mixed-Age Growth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Small seed is scattered, covered in soil, rises as fine growth, and remains beside the older stock.
subchannels.active_motifs: scattering grain and powder `quranic:root_000511:B002/m01`; fine dispersed emergence `quranic:root_000511:B004/m01`; covering seed with soil `quranic:root_001307:B008/m01`; growing and being raised among a people `quranic:root_001502:B002/m01`; young stock growing beside its source `quranic:root_001624:B004/m01`; lasting and remaining in place `quranic:root_001685:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The descendant line is materialized as cultivation: minute beginnings are distributed, hidden under soil, and raised beside an older stock. Continuity depends on both dispersal and protective covering before it becomes visible growth.

subchannels.name: Gift Joined to Record and Vocation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A gift is prepared and made durable, its elements are joined into a record, and a prophetic vocation and return are assigned to it.
subchannels.active_motifs: gift without exchange `quranic:root_001685:B001/m01`; preparing a gift for its recipient `quranic:root_001685:B005/m01`; joining parts together `quranic:root_001283:B001/m01`; entering a name in a register or company `quranic:root_001283:B004/m01`; prophetic mediation of a divine report `quranic:root_001464:B003/m01`; recompense returning from work or covenant `quranic:root_000015:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The gifted line is not left unformed: it is prepared, joined, entered into a durable register, and entrusted with a reporting office. Reward is the returning benefit of that established continuity.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Continuity is produced by scattering and covering viable beginnings, then stabilizing the resulting line through gift, record, and durable return.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 29:27 names gifted descendants, prophecy, book, and reward, while 29:17-20 supplies creating and emergence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Genealogy becomes a cultivation process and a documentary act rather than a bare list of heirs.

parent_channels.name: P3 (29:28-44) Routes and Forums Turned Hostile

subchannels.name: Cutting the Worked Road
subchannels.scene_or_process: Travelers move on a known track toward resources until an obstacle, seizure, or exhausted means interrupts passage.
subchannels.active_motifs: crossing a distance or water `quranic:root_001240:B003/m01`; a stranded traveler whose means fail `quranic:root_001240:B006/m01`; highway seizure and obstruction `quranic:root_001240:B023/m01`; an extended traversable road `quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`; road users and travelers `quranic:root_000672:B002/m01`; preventing and turning away `quranic:root_000848:B001/m01`; a route leading to water `quranic:root_000848:B004/m01`; a worked road `quranic:root_001046:B011/m01`; walkers on foot `quranic:root_000546:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Cutting the road is a full disruption of public mobility: a known worked track and its resource route are blocked until the traveler becomes "cut off" through lost mount, food, or money. The lexical assembly makes obstruction an attack on the infrastructure that lets strangers continue.

subchannels.name: The Abusive Public Council
subchannels.scene_or_process: A gathered council raises speech into public noise, circulates shame, and lets verbal reach exceed rational restraint.
subchannels.active_motifs: gathered council and consultation `quranic:root_001486:B001/m01`; raised public call `quranic:root_001486:B002/m01`; shame-producing words `quranic:root_001486:B005/m01`; excessive and far-reaching speech `quranic:root_000512:B011/m01`; a prolific speaker `quranic:root_001272:B003/m01`; talk circulating among people `quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`; tongue held back from speech `quranic:root_001036:B003/m01`; an act so hard or strange that it is rejected `quranic:root_001550:B003/m01`; verbal answer and exchange `quranic:root_000273:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The forum is not a neutral venue but an amplifier: gathering, raised voice, circulating talk, and shame-producing language create the social force of the act. The restrained tongue of عقل provides the exact counter-operation to a council whose speech has overextended its reach.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Shared channels for movement and speech are converted from public access into mechanisms of obstruction and abuse.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:29 names cutting the road and wrongdoing in the forum, while 29:38 names obstruction from the path despite perceptive capacity.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The passage links highway robbery, worked tracks, water access, public council, loud circulation, and the restraint or excess of the tongue.

parent_channels.name: P3 (29:28-44) House, Household, and Failed Support

subchannels.name: Fitted Dwelling Structure
subchannels.scene_or_process: A shelter is assembled from a standing support, a fitted socket or joint, transverse members, and joined wall material.
subchannels.active_motifs: dwelling and nightly shelter `quranic:root_000166:B001/m01`; crosspieces carrying a house-post `quranic:root_001222:B008/m01`; fitted joint, socket, or door fitting `quranic:root_000347:B011/m01`; standing tool or structural member `quranic:root_001273:B012/m01`; residence as a stable place `quranic:root_000726:B002/m01`; joining two skins or wall-halves `quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The house is a fitted mechanism, not merely an enclosure. Posts, crosspieces, sockets, and joined skins distribute load; the spider-house pressures the comparison by offering the name of shelter without dependable structural work.

subchannels.name: Household, Inhabitants, and Welcome
subchannels.scene_or_process: Kin, residents, and guests are gathered by a dwelling whose social function is recognition, qualification, and safe reception.
subchannels.active_motifs: kin and co-inhabitants `quranic:root_000064:B001/m01`; qualification for a role or place `quranic:root_000064:B003/m01`; inhabited familiarity `quranic:root_000064:B004/m01`; household and dependents `quranic:root_000166:B002/m01`; residents of a house `quranic:root_000726:B003/m01`; what gives inward familiarity and calm `quranic:root_000726:B004/m01`; gathered town and townspeople `quranic:root_001222:B001/m01`; hospitality through gathered food `quranic:root_001222:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: "Household" names more than blood descent: it is a relation of residence, qualification, familiarity, and welcome. The repeated negotiation over Lot's family therefore asks who truly belongs inside a protective social dwelling.

subchannels.name: Weak Supports and Internal Failure
subchannels.scene_or_process: A nominal shelter fails because its support is weak, its inner frame hurts, its speech is pretext, and decay consumes its material.
subchannels.active_motifs: loss of strength and resolve `quranic:root_001687:B001/m01`; a vulnerable rib or shoulder support `quranic:root_001687:B003/m01`; pain in that support `quranic:root_001687:B004/m01`; empty speech used as a pretext `quranic:root_001687:B008/m01`; a protector responsible for an affair `quranic:root_001684:B003/m01`; protective alliance `quranic:root_001684:B004/m01`; timber-eating termite `quranic:root_000025:B010/m01`; spider-house designation within a fitted joint term `quranic:root_000347:B011/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Weakness penetrates every load-bearing register: bodily ribs, household patrons, structural timber, and justificatory speech. The spider-house is weakest not because "house" is meaningless, but because the relations and members that should carry its load do not.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A dwelling is viable only when fitted structure, inhabited relations, and load-bearing supports work together.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:31-35 repeatedly distinguishes town and household, while 29:38 names dwellings and 29:41 tests protectors through the spider's house.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The spider comparison opens into joinery, tent supports, stitched panels, household membership, bodily ribs, hidden pain, and timber-eating decay.

parent_channels.name: P3 (29:28-44) Distinct Seizure Mechanics

subchannels.name: Tremor and Ground-Locked Bodies
subchannels.scene_or_process: Severe oscillation passes through earth and body until persons lose upright motion and remain pressed to the ground.
subchannels.active_motifs: violent shaking across bodies, sea, trees, or thunder `quranic:root_000545:B001/m01`; repeated disturbance and rolling motion `quranic:root_000542:B001/m01`; bodily or terrestrial shudder `quranic:root_000025:B008/m01`; clinging to the ground `quranic:root_000222:B001/m01`; the bodily mass left in place `quranic:root_000222:B003/m01`; becoming fixed in a resulting state `quranic:root_000839:B010/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The tremor is a transfer of instability from ground to body. Its outcome is not generic death but loss of stance: bodily masses end adhered to the substrate in the state in which morning finds them.

subchannels.name: Stone-Bearing Wind and Descending Impact
subchannels.scene_or_process: A force moving through the upper air lifts grit and stones, carries them, and delivers repeated impacts downward.
subchannels.active_motifs: loose stones and stony ground `quranic:root_000325:B001/m01`; pelting with stones `quranic:root_000325:B002/m01`; violent wind carrying grit or hail `quranic:root_000325:B003/m01`; upper cover, sky, and cloud `quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`; causing an affliction to descend `quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`; a calamity that comes down upon a people `quranic:root_001492:B006/m01`; weather striking land and vegetation `quranic:root_000906:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The stone-bearing punishment has an aerial transport mechanism: wind entrains particles, the sky becomes a delivery field, and impacts descend onto exposed ground. It is therefore distinct from both immersion and substrate collapse.

subchannels.name: Immersion and Engulfing Water
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water fills the available space, occupies the victim's field, and submerges until movement and life cease.
subchannels.active_motifs: sinking beneath engulfing water `quranic:root_001080:B001/m01`; land or eye filled with water `quranic:root_001080:B003/m01`; a medium occupying the whole field `quranic:root_001080:B005/m01`; a basin or depression retaining water `quranic:root_000018:B006/m01`; the gathered body of water `quranic:root_000222:B007/m01`; lower terrestrial support `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Drowning is modeled as progressive occupation: water gathers, fills, and takes over the victim's whole field. Unlike the tremor, which arrests bodies on the surface, immersion removes the breathable surface itself.

subchannels.name: Substrate Failure and Downward Disappearance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Supporting ground softens or opens, the victim is forced below its surface, and the former dwelling becomes an encircling adverse state.
subchannels.active_motifs: ground swallowing and hiding what enters it `quranic:root_000410:B001/m01`; imposed humiliation or hardship `quranic:root_000410:B006/m01`; terrestrial supporting surface `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`; heaviness and adhesion to ground `quranic:root_000025:B006/m01`; the adverse circle closing around a people `quranic:root_000499:B004/m01`; bodily condition taking hold `quranic:root_000018:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Sinking attacks the support relation itself: what appeared load-bearing becomes the medium of disappearance. The lexical field also carries humiliation, so spatial descent and loss of standing reinforce one another without collapsing into the other punishments.

subchannels.name: Acoustic Shock and Immediate Arrest
subchannels.scene_or_process: A sudden raised cry enters as an alarm or punitive blast and immediately arrests the inhabitants in their dwelling.
subchannels.active_motifs: high, penetrating cry `quranic:root_000895:B001/m01`; terrifying punitive blast `quranic:root_000895:B002/m01`; disturbance carried by sound `quranic:root_000545:B001/m02`; body fixed against the ground `quranic:root_000222:B001/m01`; adverse condition encircling a dwelling `quranic:root_000499:B004/m01`; first light exposing the completed state `quranic:root_000839:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The cry is an acoustic event rather than a wind, flood, or collapse. Its force is measured by abrupt state-change: raised sound becomes alarm and then silence, with daylight revealing bodies no longer able to leave the dwelling.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Each destroyed community is removed by a different physical operation that attacks its assumed stability.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:34,37,40 enumerates descending punishment, tremor, stone-bearing force, cry, sinking, and drowning.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The list becomes a mechanics of vibration, projectile wind, immersion, substrate failure, and acoustic shock, with distinct body states and outcomes.

parent_channels.name: P3 (29:28-44) Examples Made Legible

subchannels.name: Mark, Landmark, and Inward Sight
subchannels.scene_or_process: A distinguishing trace remains in the landscape, directs attention, and becomes inward recognition rather than bare looking.
subchannels.active_motifs: manifest sign `quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`; retained route-guiding landmark `quranic:root_001040:B002/m02`; emergence into visible clarity `quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`; gestural clarification `quranic:root_000170:B005/m02`; inward sight and evidentiary understanding `quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`; retained trace after departure `quranic:root_000180:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The "clear sign" left from the town is a trace that functions like a landmark: it first catches sight, then opens meaning, then becomes inward evidence. Remains are useful because they preserve direction after the event itself has departed.

subchannels.name: Struck Model and Rational Restraint
subchannels.scene_or_process: A maker strikes or stamps a representative form so that observers can compare structures and bind judgment to the demonstrated relation.
subchannels.active_motifs: proverbial formulation `quranic:root_001397:B003/m01`; represented model or image `quranic:root_001397:B008/m01`; example serving as an instructive sign `quranic:root_001397:B011/m01`; rendering an example explicit `quranic:root_000906:B003/m01`; type or mold for repeated form `quranic:root_000906:B007/m01`; striking tool `quranic:root_000906:B014/m02`; craft of striking `quranic:root_000906:B014/m03`; reason that restrains ignorance `quranic:root_001036:B001/m01`; tethering a moving animal `quranic:root_001036:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: To "strike" an example is to make a repeatable model whose form carries an invariant relation. عقل contributes both understanding and tether: the comparison checks wandering judgment by fastening it to a visible structure.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A truth becomes cognitively usable when it is marked, modeled, and impressed into a form that can restrain mistaken judgment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:35 and 29:44 call remains and creation signs, while 29:41-43 explicitly gives a likeness, strikes examples, and limits understanding to knowers.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Parable-making behaves like heraldry, model-making, molding, and tethering: cognition is given a durable form and then held to it.

parent_channels.name: P4 (29:45-56) Revelation From Hidden Signal to Public Text

subchannels.name: Hidden Delivery and Durable Inscription
subchannels.scene_or_process: Knowledge is conveyed discreetly, impressed into a durable surface, joined as a document, and delivered into its proper place.
subchannels.active_motifs: concealed communication of knowledge `quranic:root_001633:B001/m01`; writing and engraving `quranic:root_001633:B003/m01`; divine report and inspiration `quranic:root_001633:B004/m01`; revelation delivered downward `quranic:root_001492:B002/m02`; ordered placement into the proper rank `quranic:root_001492:B004/m01`; written document and arranged letters `quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`; binding determination in writing `quranic:root_001283:B003/m01`; extended written line `quranic:root_000422:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Revelation traverses two media without losing identity: a hidden transfer of knowledge becomes a durable inscription. Descent is also placement, so the book arrives not merely from above but into an ordered textual form.

subchannels.name: Following Voice and Recovered Presence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A reader follows a prior sequence, voice answers voice, and repeated naming restores what could otherwise pass out of active memory.
subchannels.active_motifs: following in ordered succession `quranic:root_000186:B001/m01`; a voice following another voice `quranic:root_000186:B007/m01`; inward recovery after absence `quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`; voiced naming and mention `quranic:root_000516:B004/m01`; reminder that restores presence `quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`; articulated utterance `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`; clarification through speech `quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Recitation is lexical following: the present voice walks behind an established sequence and can be answered by another voice. Remembrance keeps that chain active by repeatedly restoring the text to heart and tongue.

subchannels.name: Signs Archived in Breasts
subchannels.scene_or_process: Distinguishing signs are held in the chest as known evidence and can be produced as testimony when challenged.
subchannels.active_motifs: visible sign `quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`; disclosure to the knower `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; distinguishing mark `quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`; chest as bodily container `quranic:root_000849:B001/m01`; source from which action and expression issue `quranic:root_000849:B004/m01`; testimony that declares known fact `quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`; sign that witnesses a condition `quranic:root_000822:B008/m01`; fine awareness `quranic:root_000798:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The signs are not only external marks; they are stored in the breasts of those given knowledge. This turns the body into an archive whose contents can emerge as informed testimony, while lack of شعور names failure to access even fine-grained evidence.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Revelation moves from concealed delivery through inscription and ordered sequence into voiced remembrance and embodied knowledge.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:45-51 repeatedly joins revelation, book, recitation, writing, signs, breasts, and remembrance.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The text is simultaneously a hidden signal, stone inscription, joined document, following voice, mnemonic recovery, and archive carried in the chest.

parent_channels.name: P4 (29:45-56) Prayer as Established Restraint

subchannels.name: Standing, Direction, and Maintained Service
subchannels.scene_or_process: A worshiper takes an upright position, maintains the rite, aligns to its direction, and submits the body in service.
subchannels.active_motifs: prescribed prayer with standing and prostration `quranic:root_000879:B003/m01`; houses and places of prayer `quranic:root_000879:B007/m01`; bodily standing `quranic:root_001273:B002/m01`; sustained care and maintenance `quranic:root_001273:B004/m01`; straight alignment `quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`; submissive worship `quranic:root_000973:B003/m01`; prayer-direction faced by the body `quranic:root_001198:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: "Establish prayer" combines erection and maintenance: the body stands, the practice is kept in repair, and attention is aligned toward a direction. Prayer thereby supplies an ordered stance before it supplies a prohibitive effect.

subchannels.name: Braking, Weaning, and Ending the Wrong
subchannels.scene_or_process: Reason and prohibition arrest an act, detach appetite from it, and terminate the search for further indulgence.
subchannels.active_motifs: prohibition and active restraint `quranic:root_001560:B001/m01`; reason that prevents ugliness `quranic:root_001560:B003/m01`; sufficiency that ends further seeking `quranic:root_001560:B005/m01`; overt indecency in speech or conduct `quranic:root_001134:B003/m01`; rejected ugliness `quranic:root_001550:B006/m01`; preventing or weaning from an object `quranic:root_000994:B003/m01`; ugly conduct exceeding its measure `quranic:root_001134:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Prayer's restraint is not a vague moral influence. Its lexical mechanism is a brake that reason applies, a weaning from appetite, and an endpoint after which the act no longer solicits pursuit.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Prayer establishes a bodily and social order whose operation is to stop conduct at the boundary of the shameful and unrecognized.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:45 commands recitation and establishment of prayer, then states that prayer restrains indecency and wrong.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Ritual becomes a standing structure, directional alignment, cognitive brake, weaning process, and endpoint that makes further pursuit unnecessary.

parent_channels.name: P4 (29:45-56) Appointed Arrival and Total Enclosure

subchannels.name: Haste Against the Fixed Time
subchannels.scene_or_process: A claimant urges an event forward, but its appointed limit holds until the event arrives unexpectedly and with destructive force.
subchannels.active_motifs: fixed endpoint in time `quranic:root_000016:B001/m01`; premature acceleration `quranic:root_000987:B001/m01`; short or rapid route `quranic:root_000987:B008/m01`; surprise without anticipation `quranic:root_000135:B001/m01`; arrival and occurrence `quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`; arrival of destruction `quranic:root_000009:B011/m01`; coming into presence `quranic:root_000281:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Demanding haste cannot shorten the assigned duration. The event remains held at its endpoint, then crosses from expected future into sudden presence with no interval left for adjustment.

subchannels.name: Enclosure From Above and Below
subchannels.scene_or_process: A surrounding force closes the perimeter, covers awareness, and applies punitive pressure from both vertical directions.
subchannels.active_motifs: physical encirclement `quranic:root_000372:B001/m01`; overpowering enclosure ending in ruin `quranic:root_000372:B006/m01`; upper spatial direction `quranic:root_001188:B001/m01`; domination from above `quranic:root_001188:B003/m01`; lower direction beneath the feet `quranic:root_000177:B001/m01`; calamity that covers everyone `quranic:root_001088:B002/m01`; punishment and severe pain `quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`; experiential tasting of what descends `quranic:root_000526:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The punishment is spatially complete: perimeter, upper field, and lower footing all become active. "Taste" adds inward experience to outward enclosure, so there is no untouched position from which the event can remain merely observed.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What is demanded prematurely still arrives only at its fixed time, then occupies every available direction.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:53-55 joins demands for haste, a named term, sudden arrival, surrounding punishment, and coverage from above and beneath the feet.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Temporal impatience and spatial enclosure become one trap: an event held to its schedule becomes inescapable once released.

parent_channels.name: P4 (29:45-56) Argument Without Rupture

subchannels.name: Tightly Woven but Excellent Exchange
subchannels.scene_or_process: Two speakers review claims in a tightly wound exchange while disciplined excellence prevents verbal contest from becoming bodily overthrow.
subchannels.active_motifs: tightly twisting cord or woven material `quranic:root_000229:B001/m01`; argumentative exchange and verbal contest `quranic:root_000229:B002/m01`; throwing an opponent to hard ground `quranic:root_000229:B003/m01`; negotiation in an affair `quranic:root_001272:B009/m01`; what is beautiful rather than ugly `quranic:root_000323:B001/m01`; excellent action exceeding bare justice `quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`; interlocutors joined by religious or communal belonging `quranic:root_000064:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Debate is structurally tense like a twisted cord: its turns can strengthen a relation or be used to throw an opponent down. The "best" mode preserves tight reasoning while adding generosity beyond the minimum owed to an interlocutor.

subchannels.name: Peaceful Unity With Distinct Parties
subchannels.scene_or_process: Distinct communities remain separate participants yet converge on one object of worship and a non-hostile relation.
subchannels.active_motifs: soundness free of injury `quranic:root_000737:B001/m01`; peace opposed to war `quranic:root_000737:B004/m01`; handing oneself or an affair over `quranic:root_000737:B012/m01`; divine unity without partner `quranic:root_001631:B004/m01`; different parties united in one respect `quranic:root_001631:B005/m01`; worship directed to the deity `quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`; trusting assent `quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Unity here is not social erasure but convergence "in one respect": one deity and a shared posture of handing oneself over. Peace safeguards the distinct participants so that common worship can be affirmed without coercive fusion.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Disagreement can be tightly reasoned while preserving peace, shared orientation, and the interlocutor's human belonging.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:46 commands disputation only in the best manner, excepts active wrongdoers, and ends with one God and shared submission.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Argument is a braided cord whose strength can either hold relation together or become a wrestling grip; the best form keeps unity without erasing difference.

parent_channels.name: P5 (29:57-69) Death, Rain, and Returning Life

subchannels.name: Life-Bearing Self, Death, and Return
subchannels.scene_or_process: A living self loses force, passes through a death-state, experiences it directly, and is returned toward its source.
subchannels.active_motifs: loss of life and force `quranic:root_001454:B001/m01`; lifeless land or object `quranic:root_001454:B003/m01`; stillness and wearing out `quranic:root_001454:B012/m01`; life-bearing self `quranic:root_001533:B011/m01`; the thing's own identity `quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`; return to an earlier source or condition `quranic:root_000544:B001/m01`; living creature and animated life `quranic:root_000383:B003/m01`; experiential tasting and trial `quranic:root_000526:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Death takes the force from the very self that constituted living identity, not from an expendable exterior. "Tasting" makes mortality experiential, while return prevents that loss of force from being the route's final direction.

subchannels.name: Descending Water and Revived Ground
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water is delivered from above, enters exhausted ground, and converts it into a living, productive surface.
subchannels.active_motifs: water in its basic substance `quranic:root_001458:B001/m01`; water appearing and increasing in ground or vessel `quranic:root_001458:B002/m01`; watering by delivery and pouring `quranic:root_001458:B003/m01`; rain descending and settling `quranic:root_001492:B001/m01`; water delivered downward `quranic:root_001492:B002/m03`; land revived by rain and vegetation `quranic:root_000383:B002/m01`; soft productive ground `quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`; rain as provision `quranic:root_000560:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Revival is a material conversion: descending water enters an apparently finished substrate and reopens its productive capacity. The same rain is provision because it feeds a system before it appears as food in a hand.

subchannels.name: Directed Channels and Continuous Yield
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water is admitted into a measured channel, cuts a course through earth, and sustains continuing growth and allotment.
subchannels.active_motifs: directing water into a channel `quranic:root_000009:B004/m01`; emergence of crop, fruit, and abundant water `quranic:root_000009:B007/m01`; river cutting through ground `quranic:root_001559:B001/m01`; opening and widening a course `quranic:root_001559:B003/m01`; flowing water and rivers `quranic:root_000240:B001/m01`; continuing provision or endowment `quranic:root_000240:B006/m01`; palm-heart and new growth `quranic:root_001286:B006/m01`; beneficent condition and gift `quranic:root_001525:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Water becomes durable life only when routed: admission, incision, flow, and continuing yield form one irrigation process. The promised rivers and divine bounty are thereby linked to an engineered continuity rather than a static abundance.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Life moves through loss, return, descending water, and renewed circulation rather than remaining a self-sustaining possession.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:57 names every self tasting death and returning, while 29:63 joins rain, dead earth, and renewed life.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Mortality and revival become a hydraulic cycle of exhausted substrate, delivered water, open channels, organic yield, and restored circulation.

parent_channels.name: P5 (29:57-69) Prepared Shelter and Elevated Abiding

subchannels.name: Enclosed Garden and Settled Inner Life
subchannels.scene_or_process: Dense growth encloses a protected place, a resident is established within it, and both dwelling and inward state remain fixed.
subchannels.active_motifs: concealment from the senses `quranic:root_000266:B001/m01`; garden enclosed by dense trees `quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`; protective shield `quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`; hidden heart or inward chamber `quranic:root_000266:B010/m01`; durable continuance `quranic:root_000429:B001/m01`; settled attachment to a place `quranic:root_000429:B002/m01`; stable thought in the heart `quranic:root_000429:B004/m01`; prepared emplacement `quranic:root_000161:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The garden's enclosure is simultaneously botanical, defensive, and inward. Abiding means that resident, place, and inner composure cease to pull apart; the prepared dwelling becomes a settled state of the heart.

subchannels.name: Upper Chamber Over Flowing Provision
subchannels.scene_or_process: A resident is placed in an upper room while water and prepared provision circulate beneath the structure.
subchannels.active_motifs: upper room built above another level `quranic:root_001079:B002/m01`; drawing or lifting a measured portion `quranic:root_001079:B001/m01`; lower direction beneath `quranic:root_000177:B001/m01`; river cutting a watercourse `quranic:root_001559:B001/m01`; continuous flow `quranic:root_000240:B001/m01`; prepared provision for a lodger `quranic:root_001492:B005/m01`; agreeable place and pleasant stay `quranic:root_001525:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The image is architectural and hydraulic: elevation protects the resident while flow below continuously supplies the site. The "room" also retains the action of scooping a portion, making lofty placement and measured receipt part of one hospitable design.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A lasting dwelling combines protective enclosure, prepared placement, vertical refuge, and an uninterrupted life-source.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:58 promises garden chambers with rivers beneath and lasting residence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Paradise is articulated through shield, hidden heart, prepared lodging, upper-story architecture, and water drawn or flowing below.

parent_channels.name: P5 (29:57-69) Provision Without Self-Sufficiency

subchannels.name: Load, Guarantor, and Entrusted Care
subchannels.scene_or_process: A moving creature lacks the means to bear its store, so responsibility passes to a guarantor or entrusted agent who preserves and supplies it.
subchannels.active_motifs: carrying a visible load `quranic:root_000357:B001/m01`; guaranteeing an obligation `quranic:root_000357:B004/m01`; exhausting effort under a load `quranic:root_000357:B007/m01`; creature moving lightly or slowly on earth `quranic:root_000457:B001/m01`; path along which small creatures or water move `quranic:root_000457:B012/m01`; surety and continuing accompaniment `quranic:root_000840:B003/m01`; entrusting an affair to another `quranic:root_001681:B001/m01`; agent who suffices, guards, and manages `quranic:root_001681:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The creature's inability to carry provision is not inactivity but a mismatch between mobility and storage. Trust names a transfer of care to a competent agent, while patience resembles surety that remains with the dependent party through the interval.

subchannels.name: Spreading, Extending, and Exact Constriction
subchannels.scene_or_process: An allotter spreads resources or extends a giving hand, then narrows the quantity to an exact measure.
subchannels.active_motifs: spreading and extension `quranic:root_000116:B001/m01`; broad level ground or carpet `quranic:root_000116:B002/m01`; increase and abundance `quranic:root_000116:B003/m01`; extending the hand to give or withhold `quranic:root_000116:B004/m01`; measured quantity and limit `quranic:root_001205:B001/m01`; constricting provision `quranic:root_001205:B004/m01`; planning an allotment by measure `quranic:root_001205:B005/m01`; assigned gift or share `quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Expansion and constriction are two calibrated gestures of one allocator. The spread ground and extended hand make abundance spatial, while قدر returns it to a bounded quantity suited to the recipient and time.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Sustenance depends on apportioned expansion and reliable custody, not on a creature's ability to carry and secure its own future.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:59-62 joins patience, trust, creatures unable to carry provision, divine provision, and expansion or restriction of allotment.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Dependence becomes freight, surety, agency, crawling motion, spread cloth, extended hand, and exact metering.

parent_channels.name: P5 (29:57-69) Maritime Distress and Reversed Loyalty

subchannels.name: Unstable Vessel and the Purified Call
subchannels.scene_or_process: Passengers mount a vessel, waves destabilize its course, entanglement strips away alternatives, and a single unalloyed call is directed outward.
subchannels.active_motifs: mounting a vessel or conveyance `quranic:root_000589:B001/m01`; layers riding one above another `quranic:root_000589:B002/m01`; vessel moving on water `quranic:root_001177:B003/m01`; wave moving back and forth `quranic:root_001177:B007/m01`; vocal summons that inclines an addressee `quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`; obedience and religious submission `quranic:root_000504:B001/m01`; purification after mixture `quranic:root_000430:B001/m01`; escape from entanglement `quranic:root_000430:B002/m01`; exclusive devotion without partnership `quranic:root_000430:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Sea danger removes the illusion of stable mounting: vessel, wave, and passenger are all layers riding unstable layers. إخلاص is a filtering operation in which mixed allegiances fall away until one addressee remains.

subchannels.name: Dry-Ground Rescue and Renewed Division
subchannels.scene_or_process: Extraction reaches safe dry land; once the snare is gone, allegiance is repartitioned and the received benefit is disowned.
subchannels.active_motifs: escape by separation `quranic:root_001476:B001/m01`; raised ground beyond inundation `quranic:root_001476:B004/m01`; dry land opposed to sea `quranic:root_000104:B005/m01`; shared ownership or partnership `quranic:root_000791:B001/m01`; assigning a partner in worship `quranic:root_000791:B002/m01`; divided inward opinion `quranic:root_000791:B008/m01`; denial of a received benefit `quranic:root_001307:B004/m01`; disavowal after attachment `quranic:root_001307:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Rescue is a movement from unstable water to raised, dry footing. Precisely when the environment becomes divisible and controllable again, the previously purified relation is divided into shares and the saving benefit is repudiated.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Loss of control at sea purifies dependence to one addressee, but restored footing permits divided allegiance to reappear.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:65-66 moves from boarding ship, sincere invocation, rescue to land, renewed association, and denial of what was given.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The scene joins mounting, unstable waves, extraction from a snare, purified mixture, dry ground, partnership, and repudiation.

parent_channels.name: P5 (29:57-69) Sanctuary as Protected Perimeter

subchannels.name: Bounded Interior, Buffer, and Protected Right
subchannels.scene_or_process: A protected center is established, surrounded by a legally meaningful buffer, and held apart from external access.
subchannels.active_motifs: prohibition that blocks violation `quranic:root_000313:B001/m01`; sacred precinct and spatial buffer `quranic:root_000313:B003/m01`; protected right and inviolable bond `quranic:root_000313:B006/m01`; inward security and trust `quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`; surrounding direction `quranic:root_000373:B004/m01`; barrier separating two sides `quranic:root_000373:B005/m01`; placing something into a protected state `quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The sanctuary is not merely a point but a center-plus-buffer system. Prohibition, right, surrounding zone, and separating barrier make security spatially and normatively produced.

subchannels.name: Hooked Snatching Beyond the Boundary
subchannels.scene_or_process: Outside the protected interior, a fast taker uses sudden grip or hook to extract exposed persons before stable response is possible.
subchannels.active_motifs: rapid seizure and stripping `quranic:root_000423:B001/m01`; hooked iron or claw `quranic:root_000423:B002/m01`; predatory or human snatcher `quranic:root_000423:B003/m01`; neck-drawn speed in flight `quranic:root_000423:B004/m01`; exposed surrounding zone `quranic:root_000373:B004/m01`; direct visual apprehension `quranic:root_000531:B001/m01`; land as exposed supporting field `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The outside is defined by extraction speed: grip, hook, predator, and accelerated withdrawal leave little time for collective defense. The verse's contrast thus measures sanctuary by the predatory mechanics it suspends.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Security is produced by a bounded interior and is exposed by the speed with which predatory taking operates outside it.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:67 contrasts a made secure sanctuary with people being snatched from its surroundings.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Sacred security becomes perimeter law, buffer zone, obstacle, hooked extraction, and the difference between trusted stillness and high-speed capture.

parent_channels.name: P5 (29:57-69) Fabricated Appearance Against Fitted Truth

subchannels.name: Cutting, Stitching, and Counterfeit Surface
subchannels.scene_or_process: A maker cuts material, either repairs or damages it, then coats or colors the surface so that the finished object presents a false condition.
subchannels.active_motifs: cutting leather for repair and stitching `quranic:root_001150:B001/m01`; destructive splitting and cutting `quranic:root_001150:B002/m01`; fabricating a lie `quranic:root_001150:B003/m01`; plating base metal with gold or silver `quranic:root_001458:B005/m01`; inventing manufactured speech `quranic:root_000434:B007/m01`; false-colored patterned cloth `quranic:root_001290:B009/m01`; lie diverted from truth `quranic:root_000041:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Fabrication is craft with an ethical fork: cutting can prepare repair, or it can rupture; coating can protect, or it can counterfeit. The false product succeeds by making surface appearance deny underlying material.

subchannels.name: Turning Away From the Proper Fit
subchannels.scene_or_process: A claim is rotated away from its correct orientation, while truth is tested by whether assertion, evidence, and fitting place coincide.
subchannels.active_motifs: turning a thing from its proper direction `quranic:root_000041:B001/m01`; weakened judgment after diversion `quranic:root_000041:B006/m01`; truth fixed to reality `quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`; proof that manifests truth `quranic:root_000347:B005/m01`; part fitting its proper joint or receptacle `quranic:root_000347:B011/m01`; falsehood without stability `quranic:root_000127:B001/m01`; false assertion `quranic:root_000127:B003/m01`; contradiction of truth in speech or act `quranic:root_001290:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Falsehood is directional failure: statement and evidence are turned away from the place where they should meet. Truth is the opposite operation, a stable match like a part seated in its proper joint.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Falsehood is made by cutting, coating, or turning material away from its proper fit; truth is what remains fixed and correctly joined.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:61 speaks of being turned away, 29:67 contrasts falsehood with blessing, and 29:68 joins fabrication, lie, denial, and truth's arrival.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Lying becomes leatherwork, destructive cutting, counterfeit plating, false-colored cloth, and a misaligned joint.

parent_channels.name: P5 (29:57-69) Striving Through Difficult Terrain

subchannels.name: Exertion Until the Route Appears
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler spends capacity under pressure until the road stands out, then receives direction into its viable courses.
subchannels.active_motifs: expending capacity under hardship `quranic:root_000268:B001/m01`; being driven to the edge of capacity `quranic:root_000268:B003/m01`; road or truth becoming exposed `quranic:root_000268:B007/m01`; extended route to a destination `quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`; travelers using the road `quranic:root_000672:B002/m01`; gentle direction to path and truth `quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`; orientation and manner of proceeding `quranic:root_001583:B002/m01`; excellent action `quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Striving does not purchase guidance but brings the traveler to the point where a route can be shown as route. The plural paths are viable courses disclosed after exertion has exposed need, direction, and capacity.

subchannels.name: Hard Ground, Mountain Center, and Supported Gait
subchannels.scene_or_process: A weakened traveler crosses bare hard terrain, uses a stable central landmark, and advances with bodily support rather than uncontrolled haste.
subchannels.active_motifs: bare hard ground `quranic:root_000268:B004/m01`; stony terrain `quranic:root_000840:B005/m01`; mountain and its stable middle `quranic:root_000840:B017/m01`; route and means of access `quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`; assisted swaying gait `quranic:root_001583:B008/m01`; calm and well-formed movement `quranic:root_001583:B010/m01`; lower terrestrial surface `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The latent travel scene refuses a frictionless idea of guidance. Hard ground and stony ascent remain real; guidance supplies a stable middle, an assisted gait, and a calm manner of proceeding through them.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Sustained exertion makes a route legible and traversable, while guidance supplies direction and support proportionate to the traveler's difficulty.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:69 joins striving, guidance, multiple paths, and excellent conduct.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Guidance appears as exposed track, advance party, bodily support, hard ground, mountain center, and a gait stabilized against collapse.

parent_channels.name: P5 (29:57-69) Worldly Life as Game and Distraction

subchannels.name: Aimless Performance and Diverted Attention
subchannels.scene_or_process: An activity expends motion without a sound end while another attraction turns attention away from the lasting object.
subchannels.active_motifs: play lacking a valid aim `quranic:root_001358:B001/m01`; wind playing through and erasing a place `quranic:root_001358:B005/m01`; occupation that turns one away from another object `quranic:root_001382:B001/m01`; amusement and enjoyed diversion `quranic:root_001382:B002/m01`; the near and lower life `quranic:root_000493:B002/m01`; what comes after the first `quranic:root_000019:B001/m01`; useless inactivity `quranic:root_000127:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Worldly play is not condemned because it moves, but because its motion has no stable end and is easily erased like tracks under wind. Distraction compounds the loss by turning attention from the later reality that gives action an enduring object.

subchannels.name: Wagering the Immediate Against the Deferred
subchannels.scene_or_process: A player stakes an immediate possession, feeds resources into a game-like mechanism, and risks the deferred return for a near gain.
subchannels.active_motifs: gambling and victory by wager or deception `quranic:root_001255:B007/m01`; game or plaything `quranic:root_001358:B001/m02`; professional player `quranic:root_001358:B001/m03`; grain cast into a mill-mouth and gift likened to it `quranic:root_001382:B003/m01`; nourishment consumed `quranic:root_000560:B002/m01`; deferral to a later time `quranic:root_000019:B002/m01`; baseness of the lower choice `quranic:root_000493:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The present life becomes a wager when sustenance is fed into an immediate contest whose apparent gain is produced by postponing the real settlement. The lunar root's gambling sense makes the created moon itself a pressure on treating the near world as a gaming table.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Immediate play diverts attention from a deferred reality and consumes or risks what should sustain purposeful life.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 29:64 names the present life as play and distraction and the later dwelling as life in the fullest sense.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Diversion becomes aimless performance, wind-erased tracks, wager, mill-feed, and the exchange of a deferred outcome for an immediate stake.

parent_channels.name: S1. P1 (29:1-13) Coerced Kinship and Voluntary Obedience
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Parents press a child toward a shared allegiance, while the child distinguishes inherited bond from willing conformity.
parent_channels.active_motifs: parents as the pair from whom birth proceeds `quranic:root_001683:B002/m01`; a connected injunction entrusted to another `quranic:root_001656:B002/m01`; reciprocal exhortation within a group `quranic:root_001656:B003/m01`; forcing a person to the edge of capacity `quranic:root_000268:B003/m01`; obedience and tractable movement `quranic:root_000956:B001/m01`; agreement between two parties `quranic:root_000956:B002/m01`; the self making an act seem easy `quranic:root_000956:B006/m01`; shared ownership or participation `quranic:root_000791:B001/m01`; assigning a partner in worship `quranic:root_000791:B002/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The parental injunction is a connected bond, but its coercive extension tries to convert relation into agreement and shared cultic ownership. The scene distinguishes honoring the birth-bond from letting pressure make the self facilitate partnership.

parent_channels.name: S2. P1 (29:1-13) Hypocrisy as a Hidden Tunnel
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A person enters through a visible opening, conceals a second outlet, and uses the passage to display one affiliation while escaping through another.
parent_channels.active_motifs: underground passage with an outlet `quranic:root_001537:B003/m01`; displaying an entrance while concealing an exit `quranic:root_001537:B004/m01`; hidden interior and secret disposition `quranic:root_000464:B003/m01`; concealed corruption or deception `quranic:root_000464:B004/m01`; outsider inserted among a group `quranic:root_000464:B005/m01`; physical covering `quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`; concealment and denial of truth `quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Hypocrisy is spatialized as a two-mouthed tunnel: public entry is visible, private exit is hidden, and concealed corruption lets an inserted member change sides without crossing an exposed threshold. The image gives structural form to profession without durable belonging.

parent_channels.name: S3. P1 (29:1-13) Moral Repair and Re-entry
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A fault is covered or removed, the damaged thing is restored to fitness, and it is admitted into a sound assembly.
parent_channels.active_motifs: covering an offense until its effect is erased `quranic:root_001307:B009/m01`; ugliness and defect `quranic:root_000755:B001/m01`; identifying and censuring a fault `quranic:root_000755:B005/m01`; beneficent repair beyond bare justice `quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`; restoration opposed to corruption `quranic:root_000876:B001/m01`; fitness and compatibility `quranic:root_000876:B003/m01`; entry into an interior `quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`; parts interlocking within a body or structure `quranic:root_000464:B008/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The movement from erased wrongs to entry among the صالحين is a repair-and-fit sequence. Covering removes the operative defect, reform restores compatibility, and entry seats the repaired part within a sound whole.

parent_channels.name: S4. P1 (29:1-13) Exertion Spent on the Self
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Effort consumes the worker's own capacity and material, while the beneficiary who needs nothing remains outside that economy of depletion.
parent_channels.active_motifs: spending full capacity under hardship `quranic:root_000268:B001/m01`; exhausting a substance through use or extraction `quranic:root_000268:B005/m01`; the thing itself in its full identity `quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`; independence from need `quranic:root_001110:B001/m01`; sufficiency that stands in for another `quranic:root_001110:B002/m01`; labor undertaken with strain `quranic:root_001046:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Striving is self-consuming in the literal sense: capacity and material are spent in the worker's own process. Divine independence breaks any imagined exchange in which that depletion enriches God; its transformation returns to the striving self.

parent_channels.name: S5. P2 (29:14-27) The Migrant as Stranger in Habitable Terrain
