parent_channels.scene_or_process: A person leaves a first dwelling, crosses exposed or hot terrain with a traveling group, and arrives among people to whom he is initially foreign.
parent_channels.active_motifs: separation and departure `quranic:root_001578:B001/m01`; relocation from one dwelling to another `quranic:root_001578:B002/m01`; travel in intense noon heat `quranic:root_001578:B005/m01`; movement through land `quranic:root_000769:B001/m01`; forced removal from a country `quranic:root_000769:B005/m01`; traveling caravan `quranic:root_000769:B006/m01`; foreigner called a son of the earth `quranic:root_000025:B004/m01`; delayed residence on the ground `quranic:root_000025:B006/m02`; outsider entering another people `quranic:root_000009:B006/m01`; traveled road and terminus `quranic:root_000009:B010/m01`; clear road arriving from another country `quranic:root_001464:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Abraham's migration becomes a complete relocation scene: severance, exposure, caravan movement, foreign arrival, and eventual orientation by a clear road. "Son of the earth" usefully pressures migration as the remaking of belonging outside inherited territory.

parent_channels.name: S6. P2 (29:14-27) Fire Attack and Extractive Rescue
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A community turns fire into a weapon and a vessel of attack, exposes a target to death, and is answered by an extraction that strips the target free.
parent_channels.active_motifs: consuming flame `quranic:root_000311:B002/m01`; fire-bearing attack vessel or implement `quranic:root_000311:B008/m01`; blazing fire and its brand `quranic:root_001564:B002/m01`; taking life `quranic:root_001200:B001/m01`; making a person exposed to killing `quranic:root_001200:B005/m01`; separation from danger `quranic:root_001476:B001/m01`; stripping material free from an attached surface `quranic:root_001476:B003/m01`; manifest sign `quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The command to burn is not generic violence but a conversion of fire into a delivery technology aimed at making the victim killable. Rescue answers with an opposite material operation: separation and stripping free, leaving the failed attack as a visible sign.

parent_channels.name: S7. P2 (29:14-27) Slow Stay and Accelerated Motion
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A long residence is measured against roots that encode delay, rapid movement, and intervals whose apparent sameness hides different rates.
parent_channels.active_motifs: staying in one place `quranic:root_001339:B001/m01`; delay and slowness `quranic:root_001339:B002/m01`; year as measured residence `quranic:root_000751:B008/m01`; annual cycle `quranic:root_001063:B002/m01`; interval between years `quranic:root_001063:B010/m01`; a community as a span of time `quranic:root_000053:B008/m01`; very brief stay and rapid running `quranic:root_000973:B009/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Noah's span is textured by opposed rates: residence, delay, annual turning, inter-year interval, and sudden acceleration. The contrast prevents the large number from remaining a bare count; duration is lived as persistence against the possibility of rapid abandonment.

parent_channels.name: S8. P3 (29:28-44) Guests, Provision, and Extraction
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Arriving messengers are received as guests, provision is prepared, household status is negotiated, and the visitors become agents of extraction.
parent_channels.active_motifs: dispatch and release `quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`; messenger carrying a report `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`; prepared food and lodging for a guest `quranic:root_001492:B005/m01`; hospitality through gathered food `quranic:root_001222:B003/m01`; greeting of breadth and familiarity `quranic:root_000064:B005/m01`; glad report that opens the face `quranic:root_000120:B005/m01`; first signs heralding an arrival `quranic:root_000120:B007/m01`; rescue by separation `quranic:root_001476:B001/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The messengers occupy two roles in one hospitality frame: arrivals who should receive protection and bearers who will remove others from danger. The threatened welcome of the guest-house is reversed when the guests themselves secure the household's extraction.

parent_channels.name: S9. P3 (29:28-44) Constricted Reach Opened by Rescue
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Fear and grief constrict the chest and reduce effective reach until a rescuing arrival creates an exit beyond the person's own capacity.
parent_channels.active_motifs: extended arm and operative reach `quranic:root_000512:B001/m01`; capacity and limit of reach `quranic:root_000512:B004/m01`; constriction of the chest `quranic:root_000925:B002/m01`; fear anticipating harm `quranic:root_000447:B001/m01`; grief as inward roughness `quranic:root_000317:B001/m01`; glad report changing bodily appearance `quranic:root_000120:B005/m01`; escape by separation `quranic:root_001476:B001/m01`; rapid departure `quranic:root_001476:B002/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: "Narrowed in reach" is anatomically exact: the chest constricts and the arm's effective range contracts. Rescue does not deny that incapacity; it supplies an external route whose arrival changes fear into a body capable of departure.

parent_channels.name: S10. P3 (29:28-44) Masculinity Severed From Muruwwa
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Male status is publicly claimed while conduct exceeds moral bounds, severs social bonds, and contradicts the excellence conventionally attached to manhood.
parent_channels.active_motifs: adult male `quranic:root_000546:B002/m01`; mature humanity and manly excellence `quranic:root_001410:B002/m01`; conspicuous moral ugliness `quranic:root_001134:B001/m01`; exceeding due measure `quranic:root_001134:B002/m01`; obscene speech and conduct `quranic:root_001134:B003/m01`; cutting kinship and connection `quranic:root_001240:B007/m01`; public council `quranic:root_001486:B001/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The lexical contrast separates biological maleness from muruwwa, the cultivated completeness of human and social character. Public performance with men does not establish manly excellence when the action itself exceeds bounds and cuts the relations that excellence should protect.

parent_channels.name: S11. P3 (29:28-44) Adorned Deeds Blocking a Visible Road
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Conduct is cosmetically improved, the beautified surface captures judgment, and a barrier redirects even observers who retain visual capacity.
parent_channels.active_motifs: making a thing appear beautiful `quranic:root_000660:B002/m01`; detachable ornament and display `quranic:root_000660:B003/m01`; intentional deed `quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`; turning a traveler away `quranic:root_000848:B001/m01`; route leading toward water `quranic:root_000848:B004/m01`; ordinary eyesight `quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`; inward evidentiary sight `quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`; distance and severance `quranic:root_000796:B001/m01`; rebellious agent `quranic:root_000796:B004/m01`; arrogant refusal of truth `quranic:root_001281:B006/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The obstruction works by presentation before force: deeds receive an attractive surface, and that display recruits sight into misdirection. Remaining "perceptive" is therefore compatible with blocked insight when ornament controls what vision treats as a route.

parent_channels.name: S12. P4 (29:45-56) Provenance by Line, Hand, and False Attribution
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Authorship is tested through written trace, the hand that could make it, oath-like authorization, and the possibility of attaching words to the wrong speaker.
parent_channels.active_motifs: written line and pen-trace `quranic:root_000422:B001/m01`; divinatory lines claiming to disclose an outcome `quranic:root_000422:B002/m01`; right hand and side of action `quranic:root_001698:B002/m01`; oath and pledged word `quranic:root_001698:B003/m01`; hand as power and authorization `quranic:root_001698:B004/m01`; saying falsely that another spoke `quranic:root_000186:B009/m01`; attributing an unspoken claim `quranic:root_001272:B005/m01`; asserting what has no reality `quranic:root_000127:B003/m01`; destabilizing doubt `quranic:root_000616:B001/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The absence of prior writing and right-hand inscription is evidence about provenance, not a dismissal of writing itself. Line, hand, oath, and attribution form a forensic scene in which a false claimant would need both a trace and the authority to attach it to a speaker.

parent_channels.name: S13. P4 (29:45-56) Sufficiency That Ends Further Demand
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A supplied object fills the operative need, stops additional seeking, and remains available as nourishment and reminder.
parent_channels.active_motifs: managing an affair until need is met `quranic:root_001310:B001/m01`; declaring an object enough `quranic:root_001310:B002/m01`; provisions sufficient for need `quranic:root_001310:B003/m01`; sufficiency that ends pursuit `quranic:root_001560:B005/m01`; written document `quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`; reminder restoring presence `quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`; mercy as active beneficence `quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The book is "enough" because it continues to manage the need: it nourishes understanding, recalls what fades, and ends the search for a substitute sign. Mercy names the quality of a sufficiency that remains usable rather than merely terminating a request.

parent_channels.name: S14. P4 (29:45-56) Spacious Earth as Ground for Service
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A constrained servant is invited onto broad terrain where capacity, stride, welcome, and worship can be re-established.
parent_channels.active_motifs: earth as supporting terrain `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`; productive habitable ground `quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`; broad carpet-like land `quranic:root_000025:B005/m01`; spatial breadth `quranic:root_001647:B001/m01`; capacity to bear action `quranic:root_001647:B002/m01`; practical release from constriction `quranic:root_001647:B005/m01`; broad stride in travel `quranic:root_001647:B006/m01`; submissive worship `quranic:root_000973:B003/m01`; roads dispersing in many directions `quranic:root_000973:B010/m01`; welcome into familiarity rather than foreignness `quranic:root_000064:B005/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The earth's breadth is functional: it restores capacity to move, stride, and serve when one location has become constrictive. The dispersed-road sense of عبادة prevents service from being tied to a single coercive place, while welcome anticipates a new habitable relation.

parent_channels.name: S15. P5 (29:57-69) Ordered Celestial Circuits
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Measured celestial bodies move in rounded tracks under imposed service, making repeated motion evidence of prior design rather than autonomous wandering.
parent_channels.active_motifs: circular rotation `quranic:root_001177:B001/m01`; celestial track for sun, moon, and stars `quranic:root_001177:B002/m01`; sun and its light `quranic:root_000818:B001/m01`; moon and its light `quranic:root_001255:B001/m01`; abundance of water and pasture under the lunar root `quranic:root_001255:B008/m01`; directing a thing into service `quranic:root_000685:B001/m01`; measuring before making `quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`; originating creation `quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`; completed and balanced form `quranic:root_000434:B003/m01`; preparing and fitting a form `quranic:root_001205:B005/m02`; calculating lunar or numeric cycles `quranic:root_001205:B005/m03`
parent_channels.synthesis: The sun and moon are not merely luminous objects but components moving through a rounded, measured system. Their repeated circuits are service under design, while the moon's water-and-pasture sense connects celestial ordering to the provision system below.

parent_channels.name: S16. Whole-surah (29:1-69) Moonlit Snare Hunt
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Hunters leave under moonlight, approach behind a screen, set a snare, immobilize the quarry, and inspect whether the captured animal has died.
parent_channels.active_motifs: setting out to hunt `quranic:root_000745:B006/m01`; hunting birds or gazelles by moonlight `quranic:root_001255:B003/m01`; hunter's entangling snare `quranic:root_000791:B006/m01`; trap set for game `quranic:root_000879:B004/m01`; animal used as a hunter's screen `quranic:root_000512:B005/m01`; immobilization by binding the legs `quranic:root_001036:B010/m01`; checking whether struck quarry has died `quranic:root_001454:B014/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: False association becomes capture rather than an abstract mistake: concealment and approach end in entanglement, lost movement, and death. This concretely pressures the surah's contrast between shirk and prayer: the lexical field of شرك supplies the hunter's snare, while a lexical fringe of the prayer root supplies a set trap, so restraint must be judged by its outcome. Prayer restrains indecency while preserving moral agency; false allegiance immobilizes its captive.

parent_channels.name: S17. Whole-surah (29:1-69) Childbirth and Postpartum Recovery
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Labor approaches, a midwife receives the emerging infant, birth separates child from mother, and blood, afterbirth, and uterine pain remain as the body recovers.
parent_channels.active_motifs: pregnancy nearing delivery `quranic:root_000548:B005/m01`; midwife receiving the newborn into her hands `quranic:root_001198:B007/m01`; childbirth and release of the pregnancy `quranic:root_001683:B003/m01`; birth with postpartum blood `quranic:root_001533:B005/m01`; membrane or afterbirth emerging with the infant `quranic:root_000373:B008/m01`; uterine pain after delivery `quranic:root_000552:B004/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Generational continuity is embodied labor, not an effortless extension of a name: expectation reaches a threshold, another person receives the new life, and separation leaves blood, membrane, and pain behind. This materializes the surah's parental obligation and gifted descendants by pressing its primary creation-and-continuity reading through the bodily cost of emergence.

parent_channels.name: S18. Whole-surah (29:1-69) Timed Watering and Milk Yield
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A herder cycles stock between pasture and water, waters them at the mouth, returns a thirsty animal to the trough, and regulates drinking and milking by intervals that determine the yield.
parent_channels.active_motifs: moving camels or horses between water and pasture `quranic:root_001486:B006/m01`; drawing water at the camels' mouths `quranic:root_001198:B014/m01`; returning thirsty camels to drink again `quranic:root_000464:B007/m01`; taking milk or drink in timed portions `quranic:root_001188:B007/m01`; watering or milking at the wrong time or place `quranic:root_000967:B004/m01`; milk refilling between milkings `quranic:root_001188:B006/m01`; milk failing after seeming durable `quranic:root_001290:B006/m01`; increasing milk and offspring in a flock `quranic:root_001694:B006/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Provision is materialized as timed husbandry rather than stored possession: access, return, pause, and renewed yield must remain in balance. The scene also usefully pressures the surah's moral vocabulary. ظلم becomes a necessary act performed out of place or season, while كذب becomes milk that seemed dependable but failed; measured dependence therefore clarifies both apportioned provision and the falsity of treating yield as self-renewing.

parent_channels.name: S19. Whole-surah (29:1-69) Tanning a Hide by Measured Treatment
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A hide is removed with hair still attached, its outer surface is pared, tanning bark is applied in measured doses, and the treated material is pierced for use.
parent_channels.active_motifs: stripping the outer skin from a surface `quranic:root_000120:B004/m01`; raw hide retaining hair through skinning or tanning `quranic:root_000844:B006/m01`; salam bark used as tannin `quranic:root_000737:B008/m01`; one or two measured applications of tanning agent `quranic:root_001533:B007/m01`; piercing and cutting through the treated material `quranic:root_000273:B001/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The hide becomes usable through penetration and measured transformation, not through a decorative coating. This usefully pressures the surah's primary contrast between tested truth and fabricated appearance: a merely presented surface can deceive, whereas durable change requires removal, treatment, and an alteration that reaches the material itself.

parent_channels.name: S20. Whole-surah (29:1-69) The Grave as the Dead Person's House
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The dead body is wrapped, concealed in the ground, installed in a grave understood as a house, and left in a prolonged state of residence.
parent_channels.active_motifs: shroud covering the dead `quranic:root_000266:B009/m01`; burial concealing the body `quranic:root_000266:B009/m02`; grave as the dead person's house `quranic:root_000166:B007/m01`; prolonged residence that can describe the slain `quranic:root_000211:B001/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Death acquires a dwelling sequence: covering, concealment, installation, and continued residence. This materializes the surah's statement that every self tastes death and sharpens its comparison of dwellings: the fragile worldly house, the grave-house that holds the body, and the prepared upper chambers of the lasting return.

parent_channels.name: X1. Nontransferable Liability and Entrusted Provision
parent_channels.synthesis: Moral liability cannot be detached from the actor, so a promised substitute only acquires an additional burden. Material provision, by contrast, is precisely what a creature unable to carry its future must entrust to a sufficient guardian. The bridge distinguishes evasion from reliance by asking whether the load is constitutive responsibility or a need properly placed in care.

parent_channels.name: X2. Allegiance Reversed by Crisis and Safety
parent_channels.synthesis: In P2 a stable cultic alliance is built through affection and later reverses into mutual disavowal. In P5 danger first strips divided allegiance down to one addressee, while restored safety permits partnership and denial to return. Read together, crisis does not mechanically produce fidelity; it exposes the bond's direction, and the post-crisis act reveals whether purification became durable allegiance.

parent_channels.name: X3. Rescue as Separation and Relocation
parent_channels.synthesis: Flood, fire, a hostile town, and constricted personal reach differ as threat media, but rescue keeps the same operation: it does not merely cancel harm in place; it opens an exit and changes the endangered party's location. The rescuing role therefore progresses from preserving companions to extracting a target and finally enabling a household whose own reach has failed.

parent_channels.name: X4. Route Agency From Following to Guided Striving
parent_channels.synthesis: The surah's road sequence develops moral agency through changing travel conditions. A path can recruit passive following, migration can sever inherited location, hostile power can block public passage, breadth can restore room for service, and exertion can culminate in disclosed routes. Guidance is thus neither bare direction nor frictionless motion; it is the restoration of traversable agency under pressure.

parent_channels.name: X5. From Assay Mark to Inward Testimony
parent_channels.synthesis: Evidence progresses through material, spatial, cognitive, and testimonial roles without changing its invariant function of distinction. What pressure first marks can later guide attention, discipline comparison, enter knowledge, and be produced as witness. The whole sequence explains why seeing alone is insufficient: a sign completes its work only when its distinction survives into judgment and testimony.

parent_channels.name: X6. Return Through Limit, Re-creation, and Revived Life
parent_channels.synthesis: P1 gives return a terminus and face-to-face encounter; P2 gives it the mechanics of turning a made form back into emergence; P5 applies the same sequence to the dead self and exhausted ground. Return is therefore not repetition without change. It is a directed passage through a real limit whose outcome is presence in a renewed state.

parent_channels.name: X7. From Interior Claim to Attributed Public Record
parent_channels.synthesis: The communication chain begins before speech and ends after reception. Intention supplies provenance; delivery gives the claim a carrier; public repetition can clarify or distort; inscription and remembrance stabilize it; line, hand, testimony, and fit test its attribution. The bridge makes truth a property of the whole chain rather than of fluent wording alone.

parent_channels.name: S21. Whole-surah (29:1-69) Consecrated Approach and Marked Offering
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A pilgrim intentionally approaches the sanctuary, enters a state of consecration, assumes its distinctive garment and abstentions, marks an offering, brings it to the precinct, and circles the sacred center.
parent_channels.active_motifs: intentional approach toward a sacred destination `quranic:root_000053:B012/m01`; entering consecration and accepting ritual abstentions `quranic:root_000313:B004/m01`; consecrated pilgrim's garment `quranic:root_000313:B010/m01`; ritual sign and marked sacrificial animal `quranic:root_000798:B006/m01`; offering brought to the sanctuary `quranic:root_001583:B005/m01`; circumambulation around the house or another center `quranic:root_000957:B001/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene reframes the sanctuary from a static protected perimeter into a destination whose approach changes conduct. Intention, self-limitation, visible marking, relinquished property, and repeated centered movement make guidance and security enacted relations rather than possessions acquired merely by standing inside a boundary.

parent_channels.name: S22. Whole-surah (29:1-69) Raising Water From a Newly Dug Well
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A new well is worked, a bucket is lowered on a long rope, filled, balanced by its loop and handle, and raised through a rotating lifting apparatus so that the water can irrigate land.
parent_channels.active_motifs: newly dug well `quranic:root_000090:B008/m01`; long, tightly twisted bucket rope `quranic:root_000796:B002/m01`; water-carrier's bucket with one loop `quranic:root_000737:B011/m01`; bucket handle or sidepiece that balances the load `quranic:root_000741:B008/m01`; bucket filled nearly to the brim `quranic:root_000521:B007/m01`; windlass used to draw water `quranic:root_000373:B016/m01`; wheel or timber apparatus for lifting water `quranic:root_000987:B003/m01`; watering land by lifting water with bucket and sāniya `quranic:root_000751:B001/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: This materializes the surah's provision-and-revival reading at the point where hidden water becomes reachable. Source, rope, container, grip, rotation, and lift must remain functionally aligned; abundance below the surface is not yet received provision. The scene therefore pressures an effortless reading of sustenance while preserving the given source on which the whole apparatus depends.

parent_channels.name: S23. Whole-surah (29:1-69) Date Ripening and Palm-Leaf Collection
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An unripe date reddens, ripening advances from its tip, the ripe fruit breaks free of its peel, begins to dry, and is gathered in a woven palm-leaf basket.
parent_channels.active_motifs: unripe date turning red `quranic:root_001248:B015/m01`; ripening beginning at the fruit's tip `quranic:root_000521:B005/m01`; ripe date breaking free from its peel `quranic:root_001156:B002/m01`; ripe fruit beginning to dry `quranic:root_001684:B016/m01`; woven palm-leaf basket for dates `quranic:root_000464:B010/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Revived ground reaches provision through staged maturation rather than through instantaneous yield. Color change, localized ripening, release from the peel, drying, and collection turn created growth into food that can be received and kept. The scene thus materializes 29:60-63 and pressures any reading of provision that omits time, transformation, and a fitting receptacle.

parent_channels.name: S24. Whole-surah (29:1-69) Clarifying a Pot Over Heat
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Food is heated in a measured vessel, its harsh force is tempered, fat renders and rises, mixed matter is clarified, a thickened condiment restores consistency, and a cloth permits the hot pot to be removed.
parent_channels.active_motifs: cooking pot, broth, and the work done in it `quranic:root_001205:B007/m01`; rendered fat or oil rising over a pot `quranic:root_000064:B006/m01`; cooking that diminishes an ingredient's harsh force `quranic:root_001454:B002/m01`; clarifying butter or food from mixed residue `quranic:root_000430:B008/m01`; thickened condiment used to repair or season a preparation `quranic:root_000532:B006/m01`; cloth used to lower a hot pot from the fire `quranic:root_000248:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The domestic process materializes the surah's conjunction of measured provision and purified allegiance. Measure contains the transformation; heat exposes and tempers; clarification separates what had been mixed; repair produces a coherent food rather than a merely altered surface. Purity is consequently an achieved material condition, not a verbal claim made before pressure.

parent_channels.name: S25. Whole-surah (29:1-69) Capital Entrusted to a Traveling Trader
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An owner advances capital to a traveling trader under a profit-sharing agreement; the market opens, goods circulate and stocks diminish, and the venture can end in gain or loss of principal.
parent_channels.active_motifs: travel-based profit-sharing partnership `quranic:root_000906:B016/m01`; marketplace `quranic:root_000885:B011/m01`; market becoming active and saleable `quranic:root_001273:B018/m01`; brisk sale driven by many buyers `quranic:root_001537:B001/m01`; resulting depletion of stock or capital `quranic:root_001537:B001/m02`; loss of capital or failure to profit `quranic:root_000409:B002/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: This commercial practice gives 29:12-13 a precise countermodel. Capital, labor, risk, and profit can be contractually entrusted or shared, but a moral burden cannot be transferred by declaring it someone else's account. The scene also materializes striving and provision as exposed travel and uncertain return rather than possession without risk.

parent_channels.name: S26. Whole-surah (29:1-69) Convalescent Return
parent_channels.scene_or_process: After wasting illness, a patient's body turns toward a better condition, gradually approaches its former state, and regains consciousness, strength, and relief.
parent_channels.active_motifs: body returning to a better condition after wasting or illness `quranic:root_000544:B014/m01`; patient improving and approaching a former healthy state `quranic:root_001397:B012/m01`; consciousness, strength, and respite returning after illness `quranic:root_001188:B005/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Convalescence reframes return and re-creation as restoration of capacity after real depletion, not simple spatial reversal. It materializes the surah's repeated return sequence through a body that remains vulnerable during the interval yet can recover recognizable function and presence.
